regions.full_page: Mrs. Rose Nowicki - 40 - "lost" her little Germaine who received First Holy Comm'n Wednesday June 3rd and died following Sund'y June 7th. Doctors could not find the trouble - tested for spinal maningitis re- petedly calculated after death that it was probably a mastoid burst. Mother nearly lost her mind - even turned on gas to "put end to it all" After a moment and before too late changed her mind .... Prayers were asked at time and a number of times since. Now parents realize that she is obtaining extraordinary blessings for them and conversions of bitter-irreligious relatives. Deo Grat.
